# ClearSign Technologies Corporation to Present at H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference


**Company to Present on Tuesday, September 15th at 3:30pm ET**


**TULSA, Okla., September 10, 2026** — ClearSign Technologies Corporation (Nasdaq: CLIR) (“ClearSign” or the “Company”), a leader in advanced combustion and sensing technologies that help industrial operators dramatically reduce emissions, increase efficiency and support the use of cleaner fuels including hydrogen announced today that Chief Executive Officer, Jim Deller, Ph.D., will present at the upcoming H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference. The conference will be held September 14 – 16, 2025 with presentations, one-on-one meetings, and networking at the Lotte New York Palace Hotel in New York City. The presentation takes place on Tuesday, September 15th at 3:30 PM ET.


The presentation will be available for registered attendees via the conference platform and link can be found[HERE](https://journey.ct.events/view/670623fd-334d-440b-9df1-29f4c423ad51) . For more information about the H.C. Wainwright Global Investment Conference, please refer to the conference website at[https://hcwevents.com/annualconference/](https://c212.net/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4498481-1&h=3274293780&u=https%3A%2F%2Fhcwevents.com%2Fannualconference%2F&a=https%3A%2F%2Fhcwevents.com%2Fannualconference%2F) .


**About ClearSign Technologies Corporation**


ClearSign Technologies Corporation designs and develops products and technologies for the purpose of decarbonization and improving key performance characteristics of industrial and commercial systems, including operational performance, energy efficiency, emission reduction, safety, the use of hydrogen as a fuel and overall cost-effectiveness. Our patented technologies, embedded in established OEM products as ClearSign Core™ and ClearSign Eye™ and other sensing configurations, enhance the performance of combustion systems and fuel safety systems in a broad range of markets, including the energy (upstream oil production and down-stream refining), commercial/industrial boiler, chemical, petrochemical, transport and power industries. For more information, please visit[www.clearsign.com](https://pr.report/kg94)
